lines = file_content_str.strip().split('\n')

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        song_info = line[2:]
        # Split by " by " to get title and artist
        if ' by ' in song_info:
            title, artist = song_info.split(' by ', 1)
            songs_to_archive.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})
